SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, p.product_description, p.product_price, p.category_id, p.user_id,
,
i.inventory_id, COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) AS quantity,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) > 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'OUT_OF_STOCK' END AS product_status,
c.category_name, c.category_description,
s.user_id AS seller_id, s.user_name AS seller_name, s.user_email AS seller_email, s.user_phone AS seller_phone, s.shop_name, s.shop_address
FROM products p
INNER JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id
INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN sellers s ON p.user_id = s.user_id
WHERE i.quantity > 0
AND ( LOWER(p.product_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
OR LOWER(p.brand) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
OR LOWER(p.product_description) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
OR LOWER(c.category_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.shop_name, '')) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.user_name, '')) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) )
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND p.user_id = #{sellerId}
AND p.product_price >= #{minPrice}
AND p.product_price <= #{maxPrice}
ORDER BY p.product_name
